follow-up time: Until complete resolution of cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
study type: Parallel group, nonblinded, randomized clinical trial
outcome: Resolution of cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
cohort: 54 women with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy at <8 weeks and 6 days of gestation
finding: Hysteroscopic resection was associated with a higher success rate (100%) in treating cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy compared to ultrasound-guided dilation and evacuation (81.5%).
